description: Remove the background from any photo with real on-device AI and download a transparent PNG. Free, private and unlimited — no sign-up needed.

faqs.a: No. The AI model runs entirely in your browser using WebAssembly. Your image never leaves your device.
faqs.q: Is my photo uploaded to a server?

faqs.a: The background-removal AI model (~40MB) is downloaded from a CDN the first time you use the tool. It is then cached by your browser, so later uses start immediately.
faqs.q: Why does the first use take longer?

faqs.a: A PNG with a transparent background, ideal for product photos, profile pictures, thumbnails and design work.
faqs.q: What output format do I get?

howto: Choose a photo (JPG, PNG or WebP) by clicking the drop zone or dragging the file in.
Click “Remove background”. On first use the AI model downloads once (~40MB) — later runs are instant.
Watch the progress bar while the AI separates your subject from the background.
Preview the transparent result side-by-side with the original, then download it as a PNG.
title: Background Remover
